messages:
maria: Heads-up: got a burn-rate alert for SLO 'generation_p95' ~2x over the last hour. Anyone know where to grab the traces + recent deploys?

jon: yep seeing it too in PagerDuty. Link to alert: https://pagerduty.example/r/INC-12345

paul: @maria for dashboards check https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/slo-uptime?orgId=1 — traces in Jaeger: https://jaeger.redwood.internal/search?service=runtime-prod&operation=generate_token

maria: thx. Anyone seen a recent rollout to runtime-prod in last 30m? last successful deploy shows commit cf3a2

lex: that commit was a small batching change from my PR. I can roll it back if it's causing reg. Not oncall atm though.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout runtime-prod cf3a2 completed 1867769980 by lex

jon: can someone grab a sample trace? I suspect KV cache misses. Query to run:
```
service.name:runtime-prod AND operation:generate_token AND duration>500
```

maria: running it now, see lots of `kv_cache:miss` in logs. snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T14:10:22Z] runtime-prod gen_token req_id=abc123 kv_cache=miss latency_ms=642
```

paul: OK if kv_cache miss spike then batching/quantization shouldn't matter. Could be cache eviction after deploy. @lex any config change to cache size?

lex: no cache config changes on my PR. I only touched batching window. I'll revert the change in a canary and watch.

maria: Also suggestion: temporarily raise burn rate alert threshold to reduce noise while we triage? Current policy: 5m burn > 1.5x. Propose 2x for 30m. @sre-oncall?

sre-oncall: I'll mute the alert for 30m and create a ticket. Please post results of rollback/canary.

jon: filed: https://tickets.redwood/internal/RED-456 — adding evals and p95 latency graphs. Good call to mute.

maria: Thanks all. @lex ping me when canary ready, we'll re-enable alerts after 30m and monitor. :thumbsup:
